priorNpmPackageSummary.note: Transformers and onnxruntime-node were inherited npm package summaries, not additional advisory IDs.

advisories.precondition: The ONNX Runtime Node Linux install script must read or extract an attacker-controlled ZIP/NuGet archive.
advisories.applicationExposure: Phase 2 never invokes ONNX Runtime Node. The install script downloads a fixed Microsoft NuGet URL during Linux dependency installation; no learner archive enters this path.

advisories.patched: No patched version is listed; 0.6.1 is outside the affected range.
advisories.precondition: An attacker must control both extracted archive content and a symlink in the reused extraction destination while overwrite is enabled.
advisories.applicationExposure: The ONNX installer uses a new timestamped temporary directory and a Microsoft NuGet archive. It is absent from emitted browser and server runtime bundles.

advisories.precondition: The ONNX installer must decode a crafted archive entry with a malicious declared uncompressed size.
advisories.applicationExposure: No application upload or OCR image is passed to adm-zip; the only repository dependency call is the ONNX Runtime Node install script.

advisories.reachabilityBeforeFix: PRESENT BUT NOT REACHABLE IN PRODUCTION
advisories.precondition: Vulnerable native sharp/libvips code must process an attacker-controlled image.
advisories.applicationExposure: The sole Transformers import is the browser NER Worker. Conditional exports select transformers.web.js, where sharp is stubbed; Phase 2 image decoding uses browser APIs and Tesseract, not native sharp.

advisories.reachabilityBeforeFix: PRESENT BUT NOT REACHABLE IN PRODUCTION
advisories.precondition: Vulnerable native sharp/libheif code must process an attacker-controlled HEIF/AVIF image.
advisories.applicationExposure: Phase 2 accepts JPEG, PNG, and WebP in browser code, and the vulnerable Transformers sharp package was absent from all production trace manifests.

verification.overrideCompatibility: PASS: ONNX install-script AdmZip constructor/getEntry/extractEntryTo API, sharp native transform, and Transformers 4.2.0 Node import
verification.browserBoundary: PASS: only the NER Worker imports Transformers; its web export uses ONNX Runtime Web and stubs Node sharp
verification.bundleBoundary: PASS: no onnxruntime-node, adm-zip, vulnerable nested sharp, or libvips marker in emitted application chunks
verification.browserChunkComparison: PASS: all five emitted NeuroBERT/ONNX browser chunks are byte-identical before and after the overrides

upgradeOption.reason: It changes Transformers, ONNX Runtime Web/Node, tokenizers, jinja, and the approved runtime baseline, reopening P2-RUN-008 gates.
